summary: Mode-dispatch helper (this[7], cases 0-7) that fills a three-component position vector (this[3..5]) and a magnitude/radius (this[6]). Modes 0-5 go through sub-object+208; if that pointer is non-zero a TripleFieldQuery plus sqrt(MaxSquaredMagnitudeSearch) path runs. Mode 6 copies precomputed fields directly from the sub-object. Mode 7 either runs the same query path when sub-object+60 bit 0x10 is set, or computes the bounding-box center and half-diagonal radius via BoundingBoxComputation otherwise. Default case returns immediately.

operations.description: Initialize this[6] to 0.0 before dispatch; any case may overwrite it.
Read the mode selector this[7] and dispatch on it via the jump table at 0x0040EEA0.
Modes 0-5: load v3 from the sub-object pointer this[8] at offset +208; a non-zero v3 redirects to the LABEL_16 query path.
Mode 6: copy this[3], this[4], this[5] and this[6] verbatim from sub-object fields at offsets 0x34D4, 0x34D8, 0x34DC and 0x3B70.
Mode 7: bail out of the case when the sub-object pointer this[8] is null.
Mode 7: check bit 0x10 of the flag byte at sub-object+60; when set, run the LABEL_16 query path, otherwise run the bounding-box path.
LABEL_16 path: fill the position vector via TripleFieldQuery(this+3, this+4, this+5).
LABEL_16 path: this[6] = sqrt of the value returned by MaxSquaredMagnitudeSearch on the sub-object.
Bounding-box path: BoundingBoxComputation(&v10) fills a six-float box (min/max corners) in locals v10..v15.
Bounding-box path: set this[3], this[4], this[5] to the box center, i.e. (min+max)/2 along each axis.
Bounding-box path: set this[6] to the distance from the box center to the min corner (half the box diagonal), computed as sqrt of summed squared axis differences.
Return immediately for any mode not handled (default switch case).
